qa_pair.question: Using recipe or protocol discovery, does CmdMesh expose an MCP tool that executes recipes?
qa_pair.answer: No. Its five tools are cmdmesh_inventory_pull, cmdmesh_drift_detect, cmdmesh_recipe_list, cmdmesh_recipe_inspect, and cmdmesh_recipe_plan.
